About Artemis ABA Inc. 

 Artemis ABA Inc. is revolutionizing the Applied Behavior Analysis field through our proprietary, AI-powered platform. Our solution streamlines clinical workflows, billing, scheduling, and compliance — designed with ABA professionals in mind to deliver intuitive, scalable software that powers smarter care delivery and operational excellence.

 Role Overview 

 We are looking to hire 3 Agentic AI Developers to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents capable of autonomously performing complex workflows across our platform. While we have a preference for candidates based in Dallas, Texas, we are open to hiring exceptional talent from anywhere across the globe .

 You will work at the intersection of AI, automation, and healthcare operations — building systems that can reason, act, and continuously improve. This role is ideal for someone fluent in LLMs, multi-agent systems, and real-world orchestration who is excited to apply them in a mission-driven healthcare environment.

 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Design and develop agentic AI systems capable of autonomous decision-making and task execution

 Build multi-step AI workflows for Revenue Cycle Management, claims processing, scheduling optimization, and clinical documentation automation

 Develop tool-using AI agents with function calling, API orchestration, and retrieval systems

 Implement memory, planning, and reasoning frameworks for AI agents

 Collaborate with product and clinical teams to translate workflows into AI-driven solutions

 Optimize models for accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency

 Ensure HIPAA-compliant, secure AI implementations and continuously monitor and improve agent performance

 
 Qualifications 

 Required 

 
 3–7+ years in software development with AI/ML exposure

 Strong Python / Node.js skills

 LLM frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar

 OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLM experience

 Hands-on building of autonomous agents and API integrations

 Prompt engineering, RAG, and function calling proficiency

 AWS cloud experience

 
 Preferred 

 
 Healthcare tech / RCM / ABA domain experience

 HIPAA compliance and data security knowledge

 Vector DBs: Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS

 Multi-agent framework and planning systems exposure

 Fine-tuning and model optimization experience

 
 Why Join Artemis? 

 
 Work on cutting-edge Agentic AI — not just basic LLM integrations

 Build real-world AI systems with direct clinical and business impact

 Join a fast-growing, product-driven healthcare tech company

 Shape the future of AI in ABA therapy and Revenue Cycle Management
